payload.query:
query Meta {
  meta {
    categoryTags {
      id
      tag
      type
      textColor
      backgroundColor
      activeColor
      icon
      chips
    }
    classes {
      id
      isActive
      name
      weight
      code
      digit
      isSchoolProgram
    }
    subjects {
      id
      isActive
      lockedClasses
      name
      weight
      color
      code
      isSchoolProgram
      isEducontTeacher
    }
    customDiagnostics {
      id
      name
      classId
      subjectId
    }
    marketItems {
      ...gameItemFragment
    }
    links {
      id
      href
      icon
      label
    }
    sortVariants {
      id
      name
      type
      subjectId
      classId
      code
    }
    labels {
      _id
      name
      icon
      isGroup
      parentId
    }
    directorClassrooms {
      text
      value
    }
  }
}

fragment gameItemFragment on GameItem {
  id
  objectId
  type
  name
  price
  payload {
    value
    items {
      objectId
      chance
    }
    image
    inStore
    inGameStore
    color1
    color2
    background
    borderColor
  }
  description
  purchaseDate
  group
  weight
  isReward
  isLimited
}
